parsed.main_gap: Neither the general guarantee against arbitrary Xiang cuts nor the matching upper bound for arbitrary Liu partitions is proved.

errors.description: The proposed lower-bound argument treats only the case where Xiang cuts each length-2d piece exactly once. The crucial assertion that every other allocation of his cuts gives Liu at least as much is supported only by examples.
errors.quote: We argued they give Liu at least as much. Is it always at least (n+1)d?

errors.description: No upper-bound strategy is established for Xiang against an arbitrary initial partition, so optimality of the conjectured value remains wholly unproved.
errors.quote: Upper bound proof: Need to show for any Liu partition into ≤n+1 pieces ... Xiang can achieve final partition where Liu's draft sum ≤ (n+1)/(2n+1).

errors.description: The symmetric-pair invariant is correctly derived, but it applies only to the restricted final configuration of one split in every large piece and therefore does not complete the lower bound.
errors.quote: Thus total f = (n+1)d regardless of δ_i values.

parsed.notes: The write-up conjectures the plausible formula and proves a useful invariant for one restricted response, with numerical exploration elsewhere. It explicitly remains a tracking file with both essential general arguments unfinished.
